description: Replace Power Lora Loader (rgthree) with sequential standard LoraLoader calls to fix KeyError when the rgthree node is not available in NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS
steps: Remove Power Lora Loader (rgthree) instantiation and EXECUTE_NORMALIZED call
Replace with sequential LoraLoader calls that modify both model and clip
Store final model and clip as a tuple in powerloraloaderrgthree_138 so downstream references still work
Remove rgthree-comfy git clone from setup since it is no longer needed
Verify AST syntax and content checks pass
acceptance_criteria: No reference to NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS['Power Lora Loader (rgthree)'] in executable code
LoraLoader is used sequentially for each enabled LoRA
powerloraloaderrgthree_138[0] returns final model and [1] returns final clip
All downstream references to powerloraloaderrgthree_138 remain unchanged
verification: python3 -c "import ast; content = open('ltx23_director_mv_30s.py').read(); lines = content.split('\n'); clean = '\n'.join(['# '+l if l.strip().startswith('!') or l.strip().startswith('# %cd') else l for l in lines]); ast.parse(clean); print('OK')"
findings: The standard ComfyUI LoraLoader node handles both model and clip modification. Sequential calls chain model+clip through each enabled LoRA. The rgthree-comfy custom node repo is no longer needed since we use the built-in LoraLoader.
